godPotion.note: The wiki table lists the stat of each effect; Jerry Candy is counted because the potion page lists it. Speed and Health Regen are summed as listed and may be capped in the game. Effects with no stat (Absorption, Mana, dodge, ...) are not stats here.

accessories.src: Hypixel resources/skyblock/items (read by the app at run time through shared/names.js; not stored in the repo)
accessories.gaps: Items with no stats in the item list: the wiki infobox of each item is the only source found (not collected: ~270 pages).
accessories.statKeys: The item list mixes UPPER_SNAKE and lower_snake stat keys (for example MINING_FORTUNE and wheat_fortune); a reader must normalise them.

enrichments.note: The wiki gives one flat value per enrichment and no value per rarity; "Legendary or higher" is only the requirement. No value per rarity was found in either source.

reforges.note: one source; NEU has no accessory reforge either. A reforge name on a bag accessory is read as no stat.
